messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads up — ClearLake Finance usage down ~72% week-over-week. Renewal in 58 days. New procurement contact (Maya) added last week per CRM. Looks like a quiet account + competitive pilot flagged.
Tom (AM): Yikes. Do we have signal on which features dropped? embeddings/gen/chat?
Aisha (CS): Mostly embeddings calls and batch scoring. Chat is steady. Usage snapshot I pulled: 2026-03-01: 48k units, 2026-03-08: 13k units.
Priya (Data): Quick query result: ```SELECT date, sum(units) FROM usage WHERE tenant='clearlake' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14; 2026-03-08|13000 2026-03-07|15200 2026-03-06|15100``` shows sharp decline starting 3 days ago.
Jordan (Solutions): Any deploys or API key rotation on their side? Also any errors/failures in logs?
Aisha (CS): No deploys recorded. Error rate small. We do see increased 4xx from their ingestion endpoint — likely a client-side schema change.
Tom (AM): Also saw a procurement note: Maya evaluating Vendor: Lunatech for embeddings POC. Can someone find the pilot owner/size?
Priya (Data): I pulled pilot mentions in notes — Lunatech pilot for 100k vectors, starting last week. No contract sig.
Aisha (CS): Proposed plan: 1) Quick technical sync (Jordan + eng) to resolve 4xx and test ingestion. 2) Exec touch from Tom to Maya to surface renewal timeline. 3) Offer 30-day demo credits + migration support to win back confidence. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jordan (Solutions): I can take tech sync today. Need API key, sample payload, and a failing example. Aisha can you get that?
Aisha (CS): On it. Maya gave sample payloads in the email thread — forwarding now.
Tom (AM): I'll request a 15-min sync with Maya and their head of ML. If they push procurement, offer a short SEP (migration packet) and a cost comparison vs Lunatech.
Priya (Data): Also recommend we run automated eval on recent inference outputs vs their baseline to show parity/quality. I can prepare a 1-page QA report in 48h.
notif-bot: Reminder: Renewal alert created for clearlake — 58 days left.
Aisha (CS): Flagging risk level: elevated. Assigning playbook: "quiet-usage-with-competitive-pilot". Owners: Tom (exec), Jordan (tech), Priya (evidence), Aisha (CS lead).
Tom (AM): I'll own the exec outreach. Jordan please send me 2 available slots. Priya, set expectation of 48h for QA.
Jordan (Solutions): Slots: today 4pm PT or tomorrow 10am PT. Which works for you @Tom?
Tom (AM): 4pm PT works. Booked.
Aisha (CS): After tech sync we'll prepare a small remediation patch and a rollout doc for their infra team. Also propose a short success metric: restore to >=70% baseline usage or a migration plan agreed within 14 days.
Priya (Data): Noted. I'll include baseline task list and quick eval template.
Tom (AM): Final ask — anyone seen churn language from their execs? Legal/Procurement red flags?
Aisha (CS): Procurement notes: "evaluating options" only. No hard stop. I'll escalate to CSM weekly cadence until renewal. :calendar:
Jordan (Solutions): Taking tech action items now. Will post logs and repro steps in this thread when ready.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team. I'll update Salesforce and add meeting notes after the 4pm. :thumbsup:
Tom (AM): Thanks. Let’s try to avoid late-stage renewal scramble.
Aisha (CS): Closing loop — confirmed demo credits approved by finance for up to $6k. 
Priya (Data): QA report template link: https://rdw.in/clearlake-eval (draft).
Jordan (Solutions): Posted failing request/response and a suggested fix in the thread.
Aisha (CS): Next update after tech sync and exec touch.
